fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM98,350. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057147/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: i. Passed Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) or equivalent with a minimum of Grade C (NGMP 2.00) in 2 subjects and a credit in English at SPM level or equivalent; OR ii. Passed Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM) with a minimum of Jayyid Grade and a credit in English at SPM level or equivalent; OR iii. Passed Diploma (Level 4, MQF) or equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and a credit in English at SPM level or equivalent; OR iv. Passed Diploma (Level 4, MQF) in Media and Communication or equivalent; OR v. Passed Matriculation/Foundation or equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and a credit in English at SPM level or equivalent; OR vi. Passed Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with a minimum of Grade B in 5 subjects including English; OR vii. Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Malaysian Government. Note: The English requirement at SPM level may be waived if the prior qualification includes English with equivalent or higher achievement. International Students: TOEFL 500 or IELTS 5.0 or equivalent
